mapper.sql: SELECT 1 FROM recipe_ingredient ingredient INNER JOIN recipe recipe ON recipe.recipe_id = ingredient.recipe_id AND recipe.current_version = ingredient.recipe_version INNER JOIN recipe_version version ON version.recipe_id = recipe.recipe_id AND version.version = recipe.current_version AND version.status_code = 2 WHERE ingredient.food_item_id = CAST(food.id AS CHAR)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(food.id AS CHAR) AS id, food.name, food.category_code AS categoryCode FROM food food WHERE food.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS () ORDER BY food.id

SELECT CAST(nutrient.food_id AS CHAR) AS foodId, nutrient.nutrient_code AS nutrientCode, nutrient.amount FROM food_nutrient nutrient INNER JOIN food food ON food.id = nutrient.food_id AND food.is_deleted = 0 WHERE nutrient.is_deleted = 0 AND nutrient.nutrient_code IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) AND EXISTS ()

SELECT recipe.recipe_id AS id, recipe.display_name AS name, COALESCE(( SELECT equipment.equipment_code FROM recipe_equipment_variant equipment WHERE equipment.recipe_id = recipe.recipe_id AND equipment.recipe_version = recipe.current_version ORDER BY equipment.id LIMIT 1 ), '') AS cookware, COALESCE(( SELECT step.instruction_text FROM recipe_step step WHERE step.recipe_id = recipe.recipe_id AND step.recipe_version = recipe.current_version ORDER BY step.step_no LIMIT 1 ), '') AS step, recipe.current_version AS version FROM recipe recipe INNER JOIN recipe_version version ON version.recipe_id = recipe.recipe_id AND version.version = recipe.current_version AND version.status_code = 2 ORDER BY recipe.recipe_id

SELECT ingredient.recipe_id AS recipeId, ingredient.food_item_id AS foodId, ingredient.quantity AS grams FROM recipe_ingredient ingredient INNER JOIN recipe recipe ON recipe.recipe_id = ingredient.recipe_id AND recipe.current_version = ingredient.recipe_version INNER JOIN recipe_version version ON version.recipe_id = recipe.recipe_id AND version.version = recipe.current_version AND version.status_code = 2 ORDER BY ingredient.recipe_id, ingredient.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipe_nutrition_result (recipe_id, recipe_version, nutrient_code, nutrient_value, unit_code, quality_code, source_ref) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{version}, #{nutrientCode}, #{amount}, #{unitCode}, #{qualityCode}, #{sourceRef}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE nutrient_value = VALUES(nutrient_value), unit_code = VALUES(unit_code), quality_code = VALUES(quality_code), source_ref = VALUES(source_ref)
